title: Every Walgreens pharmacy permit in California dated the same day
question: When were the State permits of the pharmacies in the drug screens issued?
finding: 486 of the 488 Walgreens retail-pharmacy permits in the Board of Pharmacy file carry the original issue date 28 August 2025, including 32 of the 32 in San Francisco. California retail-pharmacy permits issued in 2025: 817, against 284 the year before. Stores that Medicaid paid in 2018-2024 therefore show a permit newer than the payments.
how: Retail pharmacy permits (type PHY) whose name contains Walgreen, counted by original issue date; all California retail permits counted by year of issue.
limits: The Board issues a new permit when a pharmacy changes owner or corporate form, so one date across a chain points to a corporate change, not to stores that operated without permits. The file does not say why the permits were reissued; the Board's change-of-ownership files would.
